properties.name: Whinlatter Pass B5292
properties.reason: Twisty forest pass but a normal B-road. Generally suitable for Penfold; use care for cyclists, forestry traffic and winter conditions.

properties.name: Haweswater reservoir road
properties.reason: Narrow dead-end reservoir road but generally manageable for Transporter-sized vehicles. Expect walkers, livestock and meeting traffic.

properties.name: Kentmere valley road
properties.reason: Very narrow rural access with walls and hedges and few easy passing opportunities. Penfold can fit but satnav shortcuts here deserve caution.

properties.name: A590/A591 South Lakes approach
properties.reason: Primary strategic approach to the South Lakes, used by coaches and commercial traffic. Default green for Penfold.

properties.name: A4085 Beddgelert–Rhyd Ddu
properties.reason: Twisty mountain A-road with narrow sections but fundamentally suitable for a VW Transporter-sized camper.
properties.evidence: National Park campervan guidance + road class

properties.name: B4413 Llŷn Peninsula / Aberdaron
properties.reason: Rural peninsula B-road with narrow sections and seasonal traffic. Penfold is a sensible size; avoid tiny coastal-lane diversions.

properties.name: B4391 Bala–Llangynog
properties.reason: Scenic cross-country B-road with bends and narrower sections but generally a practical Penfold route.

properties.name: A483 central Wales corridor
properties.reason: Principal north-south road through central and eastern Wales. Default suitable for Penfold except signed or temporary restrictions.

properties.name: A487 west Wales corridor
properties.reason: Primary west-Wales route linking major towns. Generally the sensible Penfold choice compared with smaller coastal alternatives.

properties.name: A44 Ponterwyd–Aberystwyth
properties.reason: Main trunk-road approach across the Cambrian Mountains. Bendy and exposed, but built for regular through traffic and suitable for Penfold.

properties.name: A87 Portree–Uig
properties.reason: Main north-Skye route, regularly used by buses and commercial traffic. Default green for Penfold, with weather as the main caveat.

properties.name: A82 Rannoch Moor
properties.reason: Major trunk route across exposed moorland, used by coaches and HGVs. Default green for Penfold, with wind, ice and snow as the main risks.

properties.name: B863 Kinlochleven loop
properties.reason: Scenic loch-side B-road with bends and narrower sections. Penfold is well-sized for it; expect cyclists and tourist traffic.

properties.name: Glen Lyon road
properties.reason: Long narrow glen road, largely single-track with limited passing. Penfold fits but reversing and patience are part of the route.

properties.name: Loch Quoich road
properties.reason: Remote single-track road along Loch Quoich with very limited services and long reversing possibilities. Suitable only as an intentional excursion.

properties.name: A861 Corran–Acharacle
properties.reason: Long scenic west-coast road with single-track sections. Penfold is a sensible campervan size; journey time and passing places matter more than dimensions.

properties.name: A884 Morvern
properties.reason: Remote Highland A-road with stretches of single track. Generally suitable for Penfold if you are comfortable with passing-place etiquette.

properties.name: A849 Isle of Mull
properties.reason: Main Mull route but much of the island network is single-track. Penfold is appropriate; slow progress and correct passing-place use are expected.

properties.name: B885 Portree–Bracadale
properties.reason: Cross-island B-road with narrow and single-track sections. Penfold fits, but it is slower and more constrained than the A87.

properties.name: A855 Portree–Staffin
properties.reason: Main east-Skye scenic road; narrow in places but normal territory for campervans. Quiraing deviations are assessed separately.

properties.name: B9176 Struie Road
properties.reason: Scenic B-road shortcut with bends and elevation change, but generally suitable for Penfold. Use normal Highland rural-road caution.
